tbesh_html:
1) to hang, languish, hang down, be low
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to hang low
1a2) to be low
1a3) of distress (fig.)
1a4) to languish, look weakly (of eyes)
1b) (Niphal) to be brought low, be laid low

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to slacken or be feeble; figuratively, to be oppressed
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bring low, dry up, be emptied, be not equal, fail, be impoverished, be made thin.
